_sql.kpi:
-- Ringkasan bisnis untuk seluruh periode (Jan 2017 - Agu 2018).
WITH valid AS (SELECT * FROM f_orders WHERE is_valid),
per_customer AS (SELECT customer, COUNT(*) AS n FROM valid GROUP BY customer)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM valid)                                   AS orders,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM per_customer)                            AS customers,
  (SELECT ROUND(SUM(items_value), 2) FROM valid)                 AS gmv,
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(items_value), 2) FROM valid WHERE item_count > 0) AS avg_order_value,
  (SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(n > 1) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM per_customer) AS repeat_customer_pct,
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) FROM valid WHERE review_score IS NOT NULL) AS avg_review,
  (SELECT ROUND(100.0 * AVG(delay_days > 0), 2) FROM v_delivered) AS late_pct,
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(delivery_days), 1) FROM v_delivered)          AS avg_delivery_days,
  (SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(freight_value) / SUM(items_value), 1) FROM valid) AS freight_to_value_pct;
_sql.monthly:
-- Tren bulanan: pesanan, GMV, pelanggan baru vs pelanggan lama, dan persen terlambat.
WITH valid AS (SELECT * FROM f_orders WHERE is_valid),
first_month AS (SELECT customer, MIN(month) AS first_month FROM valid GROUP BY customer)
SELECT v.month,
       COUNT(*)                                           AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(v.items_value), 2)                       AS gmv,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN v.month = f.first_month THEN v.customer END) AS new_customers,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN v.month > f.first_month THEN v.customer END) AS returning_customers,
       ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN v.status = 'delivered' AND v.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
                              THEN v.delay_days > 0 END), 1) AS late_pct,
       ROUND(AVG(v.review_score), 2)                      AS avg_review
FROM valid v
JOIN first_month f USING (customer)
GROUP BY v.month
ORDER BY v.month;
_sql.cohort_retention:
-- Retensi per cohort: dari pelanggan yang pertama belanja di bulan X,
-- berapa persen yang belanja lagi k bulan kemudian (k = 1..6).
WITH valid AS (SELECT customer, month FROM f_orders WHERE is_valid),
first_month AS (SELECT customer, MIN(month) AS cohort FROM valid GROUP BY customer),
activity AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.cohort,
         v.customer,
         (CAST(substr(v.month, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(f.cohort, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) * 12
       + (CAST(substr(v.month, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(f.cohort, 6, 2) AS INTEGER)) AS k
  FROM valid v JOIN first_month f USING (customer)
),
size AS (SELECT cohort, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM first_month GROUP BY cohort)
SELECT s.cohort,
       s.customers,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.k = 1 THEN a.customer END) / s.customers, 2) AS m1,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.k = 2 THEN a.customer END) / s.customers, 2) AS m2,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.k = 3 THEN a.customer END) / s.customers, 2) AS m3,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.k = 4 THEN a.customer END) / s.customers, 2) AS m4,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.k = 5 THEN a.customer END) / s.customers, 2) AS m5,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.k = 6 THEN a.customer END) / s.customers, 2) AS m6,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.k BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN a.customer END) / s.customers, 2) AS within_6m,
       -- bulan cohort ditambah k yang masih di dalam periode data (s.d. 2018-08)
       (2018 - CAST(substr(s.cohort, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) * 12 + (8 - CAST(substr(s.cohort, 6, 2) AS INTEGER)) AS months_observed
FROM size s
LEFT JOIN activity a USING (cohort)
GROUP BY s.cohort
ORDER BY s.cohort;
_sql.rfm_segments:
-- Segmentasi RFM per pelanggan, tanggal acuan 2018-09-01.
-- R dan M dibagi 5 kelompok (NTILE). F tidak dibagi rata karena 97% pelanggan
-- hanya belanja sekali; F diberi skor 1 (sekali), 4 (dua kali), 5 (tiga kali atau lebih).
WITH valid AS (SELECT * FROM f_orders WHERE is_valid AND item_count > 0),
base AS (
  SELECT customer,
         CAST(julianday('2018-09-01') - julianday(MAX(purchased_at)) AS INTEGER) AS recency_days,
         COUNT(*)          AS frequency,
         SUM(items_value)  AS monetary
  FROM valid
  GROUP BY customer
),
scored AS (
  SELECT *,
         6 - NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY recency_days) AS r,
         CASE WHEN frequency >= 3 THEN 5 WHEN frequency = 2 THEN 4 ELSE 1 END AS f,
         NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY monetary) AS m
  FROM base
),
segmented AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE
           WHEN f >= 4 AND r >= 4                 THEN 'Champions'
           WHEN f >= 4                            THEN 'Loyal, mulai pasif'
           WHEN r >= 4 AND m >= 4                 THEN 'Baru, nilai tinggi'
           WHEN r >= 4                            THEN 'Baru, nilai rendah'
           WHEN r = 3                             THEN 'Perlu perhatian'
           WHEN m >= 4                            THEN 'Nilai tinggi, hampir hilang'
           ELSE                                        'Hilang'
         END AS segment
  FROM scored
)
SELECT segment,
       COUNT(*)                                        AS customers,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS customers_pct,
       ROUND(SUM(monetary), 2)                         AS gmv,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(monetary) / SUM(SUM(monetary)) OVER (), 2) AS gmv_pct,
       ROUND(AVG(recency_days), 0)                     AS avg_recency_days,
       ROUND(AVG(frequency), 2)                        AS avg_frequency,
       ROUND(AVG(monetary), 2)                         AS avg_monetary
FROM segmented
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY gmv DESC;
_sql.categories:
-- Kinerja kategori: GMV, pangsa, pangsa kumulatif (Pareto), rating, keterlambatan,
-- dan persen pembeli yang kembali (pelanggan yang belanja lagi di kategori apa pun).
WITH valid_items AS (
  SELECT i.*, o.customer, o.review_score, o.delay_days, o.status, o.delivered_at
  FROM f_items i JOIN f_orders o USING (order_id)
  WHERE o.is_valid
),
cust_orders AS (SELECT customer, COUNT(*) AS n FROM f_orders WHERE is_valid GROUP BY customer),
cat AS (
  SELECT category,
         COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)                    AS orders,
         SUM(price)                                  AS gmv,
         AVG(price)                                  AS avg_price,
         AVG(freight_value / NULLIF(price, 0))       AS freight_ratio
  FROM valid_items GROUP BY category
),
cat_orders AS (   -- satu baris per (kategori, pesanan) supaya rating tidak terhitung ganda
  SELECT DISTINCT category, order_id, customer, review_score, delay_days, status, delivered_at
  FROM valid_items
),
cat_quality AS (
  SELECT category,
         AVG(review_score) AS avg_review,
         AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'delivered' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL THEN delay_days > 0 END) AS late_rate
  FROM cat_orders
  GROUP BY category
),
cat_repeat AS (   -- per pelanggan, bukan per pesanan, supaya pelanggan yang sering belanja tidak terhitung ganda
  SELECT cc.category, AVG(co.n > 1) AS repeat_rate
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT category, customer FROM cat_orders) cc
  JOIN cust_orders co USING (customer)
  GROUP BY cc.category
)
SELECT c.category,
       c.orders,
       ROUND(c.gmv, 2)                                   AS gmv,
       ROUND(100.0 * c.gmv / SUM(c.gmv) OVER (), 2)      AS gmv_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(c.gmv) OVER (ORDER BY c.gmv DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) / SUM(c.gmv) OVER (), 2) AS cum_gmv_pct,
       ROUND(c.avg_price, 2)                             AS avg_price,
       ROUND(100.0 * c.freight_ratio, 1)                 AS freight_pct_of_price,
       ROUND(q.avg_review, 2)                            AS avg_review,
       ROUND(100.0 * q.late_rate, 1)                     AS late_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * rp.repeat_rate, 2)                  AS repeat_customer_pct
FROM cat c JOIN cat_quality q USING (category) JOIN cat_repeat rp USING (category)
ORDER BY c.gmv DESC;
_sql.delivery_vs_review:
-- Hubungan ketepatan pengiriman dengan rating.
-- delay_days < 0 = tiba sebelum estimasi.
SELECT CASE
         WHEN delay_days <= -8 THEN '1. Lebih cepat > 7 hari'
         WHEN delay_days <= 0  THEN '2. Lebih cepat 0-7 hari'
         WHEN delay_days <= 3  THEN '3. Terlambat 1-3 hari'
         WHEN delay_days <= 7  THEN '4. Terlambat 4-7 hari'
         ELSE                       '5. Terlambat > 7 hari'
       END AS bucket,
       COUNT(*)                                       AS orders,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS orders_pct,
       ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2)                    AS avg_review,
       ROUND(100.0 * AVG(review_score <= 2), 1)       AS bad_review_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * AVG(review_score = 5), 1)        AS five_star_pct
FROM v_delivered
WHERE review_score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket;
_sql.late_first_order_retention:
-- Apakah pengalaman pertama memengaruhi pembelian berikutnya?
-- Pelanggan dikelompokkan menurut pesanan PERTAMA mereka (terlambat atau tidak, rating),
-- lalu dihitung berapa persen yang belanja lagi. Pesanan pertama dibatasi s.d. Feb 2018
-- supaya setiap pelanggan punya minimal 6 bulan untuk kembali.
WITH valid AS (SELECT * FROM f_orders WHERE is_valid),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer ORDER BY purchased_at, order_id) AS rn,
            COUNT(*)     OVER (PARTITION BY customer) AS n
  FROM valid
),
first_orders AS (
  SELECT * FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1 AND purchased_at < '2018-03-01'
    AND status = 'delivered' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 'Pengiriman' AS dimension,
       CASE WHEN delay_days > 0 THEN 'Terlambat' ELSE 'Tepat waktu' END AS first_order,
       COUNT(*) AS customers,
       ROUND(100.0 * AVG(n > 1), 2) AS repeat_pct
FROM first_orders GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Rating',
       CASE WHEN review_score <= 2 THEN 'Bintang 1-2'
            WHEN review_score = 3  THEN 'Bintang 3'
            ELSE 'Bintang 4-5' END,
       COUNT(*),
       ROUND(100.0 * AVG(n > 1), 2)
FROM first_orders WHERE review_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;
_sql.states:
-- Kinerja per negara bagian pembeli: lama kirim, keterlambatan, ongkir, rating.
SELECT state,
       COUNT(*)                                      AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(items_value), 2)                    AS gmv,
       ROUND(AVG(delivery_days), 1)                  AS avg_delivery_days,
       ROUND(100.0 * AVG(delay_days > 0), 1)         AS late_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(freight_value) / SUM(items_value), 1) AS freight_pct_of_value,
       ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2)                   AS avg_review
FROM v_delivered
GROUP BY state
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100
ORDER BY orders DESC;
_sql.sellers:
-- Konsentrasi penjual dan penjual bermasalah.
-- Desil penjual menurut GMV; persen GMV, keterlambatan dan rating per desil.
WITH s AS (
  SELECT i.seller_id,
         SUM(i.price)                    AS gmv,
         COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id)      AS orders,
         AVG(CASE WHEN o.status = 'delivered' AND o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL THEN o.delay_days > 0 END) AS late_rate,
         AVG(o.review_score)             AS avg_review
  FROM f_items i JOIN f_orders o USING (order_id)
  WHERE o.is_valid
  GROUP BY i.seller_id
),
d AS (SELECT *, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY gmv DESC) AS decile FROM s)
SELECT decile,
       COUNT(*)                                          AS sellers,
       SUM(orders)                                       AS orders,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(gmv) / SUM(SUM(gmv)) OVER (), 2) AS gmv_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(late_rate * orders) / SUM(orders), 1) AS late_pct,
       ROUND(SUM(avg_review * orders) / SUM(orders), 2)  AS avg_review
FROM d
GROUP BY decile
ORDER BY decile;
_sql.problem_sellers:
-- Semua penjual aktif (>= 50 pesanan terkirim), diurutkan dari yang paling sering terlambat.
-- Dampak = berapa banyak pesanan terlambat yang mereka hasilkan.
WITH s AS (
  SELECT i.seller_id,
         se.seller_state,
         COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)                          AS delivered_orders,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.delay_days > 0 THEN o.order_id END) AS late_orders,
         AVG(o.review_score)                                 AS avg_review,
         SUM(i.price)                                        AS gmv
  FROM f_items i
  JOIN v_delivered o USING (order_id)
  JOIN sellers se USING (seller_id)
  GROUP BY i.seller_id, se.seller_state
)
SELECT substr(seller_id, 1, 8)                         AS seller,
       seller_state,
       delivered_orders,
       late_orders,
       ROUND(100.0 * late_orders / delivered_orders, 1) AS late_pct,
       ROUND(avg_review, 2)                             AS avg_review,
       ROUND(gmv, 2)                                    AS gmv
FROM s
WHERE delivered_orders >= 50
ORDER BY late_pct DESC, late_orders DESC;
_sql.purchase_timing:
-- Kapan pelanggan berbelanja: hari (0 = Minggu) x jam.
SELECT CAST(strftime('%w', purchased_at) AS INTEGER) AS weekday,
       CAST(strftime('%H', purchased_at) AS INTEGER) AS hour,
       COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM f_orders
WHERE is_valid
GROUP BY weekday, hour
ORDER BY weekday, hour;
_sql.payments:
-- Cara bayar dan cicilan.
WITH p AS (
  SELECT op.*
  FROM order_payments op JOIN f_orders o USING (order_id)
  WHERE o.is_valid AND op.payment_type <> 'not_defined'
)
SELECT payment_type,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)                               AS orders,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(payment_value) / SUM(SUM(payment_value)) OVER (), 2) AS value_pct,
       ROUND(AVG(payment_value), 2)                           AS avg_payment,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'credit_card' THEN payment_installments END), 2) AS avg_installments
FROM p
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY orders DESC;
_sql.promise_vs_speed:
-- Mana yang lebih menentukan rating: lama kirim, atau janji (estimasi) ditepati?
-- Rating dibandingkan per kelompok lama kirim, dipisah tepat waktu vs terlambat.
SELECT CASE
         WHEN delivery_days <= 7  THEN '1. s.d. 7 hari'
         WHEN delivery_days <= 14 THEN '2. 8-14 hari'
         WHEN delivery_days <= 21 THEN '3. 15-21 hari'
         ELSE                          '4. lebih dari 21 hari'
       END AS delivery_time,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN delay_days <= 0 THEN review_score END), 2) AS review_on_time,
       SUM(delay_days <= 0)                                             AS orders_on_time,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN delay_days > 0 THEN review_score END), 2)  AS review_late,
       SUM(delay_days > 0)                                              AS orders_late
FROM v_delivered
WHERE review_score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY delivery_time
ORDER BY delivery_time;
